content:
Maya Chen: Hey team — last-minute ask. I need to swap my Sat 06:00-14:00 oncall block. Family thing came up, sorry for the short notice. Can anyone take Sat morning?

Ben Ortiz: I can take part of it — I’m free 06:00-10:00. Can someone cover 10:00-14:00? :wave:

Jordan Patel: I can pick up 10:00-14:00. Ben, you good if we do a brief handoff at 09:50?

Maya Chen: @Ben @Jordan huge thanks. Yes please do a handoff at 09:50. Also FYI: there's a small config rollout scheduled Sat 00:30 — low risk but worth a deploy-watch in case the canary misbehaves. If someone can watch overnight I’ll owe you coffee.

sre-bot: Deploy scheduled: config/redwood-routing v2.1 -> canary at 2026-03-21T00:30Z; owners: infra-deploy. Monitor /deploys and /console/latency.

Liam O'Connor: I can do the deploy-watch 00:30-02:30. I’ll set up alerts and keep an eye on tail latency.

Nora Singh: I can be backup for the deploy-watch from 02:30-04:00 if you want to nap, @Liam :coffee:

Ben Ortiz: 09:50 handoff works. Quick question — any prewarm we should run for the model cache after config change? Last time we saw a small spike in cold KV misses.

Maya Chen: Good call. Runbook-lite below (super short):

```
# runbook-lite: prewarm & basic checks
1) before shift: open https://console/redwood/metrics -> route: api/generation latency 95th
2) prewarm KV cache: curl -X POST https://infra-api/prewarm -d '{"prefixes": ["/gpt/", "/emb/"]}'
3) tail logs for canary: kubectl logs -l app=redwood-router -f --since=1m
4) if error rate >1% or 95th latency +200ms, rollback: kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-router
```

Liam O'Connor: Nice concise. I’ll run the prewarm 00:15 and post a short check at 00:28.

Jordan Patel: For the handoff at 09:50 — Ben, I’ll DM a brief checklist (tickets, ongoing paged items, any warmup commands).

Ben Ortiz: Perfect. One more thing: if the canary trips automated fallback, does traffic automatically route to the previous model variant, or do we need to manually flip?

Maya Chen: Auto-fallback is enabled for this rollout (policy: immediate fallback to v2 when errors >= 2%). You should still verify artifacts: check `/model-catalog/v2.1` vs v2 on console. If fallback happens, ping infra-deploy and me.

Nora Singh: tagging runbook link in channel for easy access: https://internal/docs/runbooks/prewarm-lite :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Reminder: Pager policy — oncall owner receives pages; backup gets only high-severity.

Ben Ortiz: Thanks everyone, taking 06:00-10:00. Will be online ~05:55 for quick boot checks.

Maya Chen: Thank you all — really appreciate the quick covers. I’ll update the schedule and add the handoff time to the calendar invite. :heart:

Jordan Patel: See you at 09:50 handoff. Good luck with the deploy-watch @Liam and @Nora.

Liam O'Connor: I’ll post a checklist message right before 00:15 with the prewarm success/failure.

Nora Singh: If anything gets noisy overnight ping me and I’ll jump in. :thumbsup:
